segments.say: Loopback Transformer. Towards a unified view of residual looped transformers.
segments.display: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers.

segments.say: A looped transformer runs the same blocks again and again. That saves parameters, but with plain addition, the updates from every pass just pile up.
segments.display: A looped Transformer runs the same blocks again and again. That saves parameters, but with plain addition, the updates from every pass just pile up.

segments.say: So we built Loopback. It stores each block's update and keeps the input on its own path. A decay limits how much old updates count, and attention picks which ones to read.
segments.display: So we built Loopback. It stores each block's update and keeps the input on its own path. A decay limits how much old updates count, and attention picks which ones to read.

segments.say: Here a standard transformer and Loopback, both at three billion scale, read the same new text. Loopback is twenty-three percent smaller, and its loss still ends lower.
segments.display: Here a standard Transformer and Loopback, both at 3B scale, read the same new text. Loopback is 23% smaller, and its loss still ends lower.

segments.say: From one hundred ninety-one million to three billion parameters, Loopback gets lower loss than the standard transformer with forty to seventy-five percent of its parameters.
segments.display: From 191M to 3B parameters, Loopback gets lower loss than the standard Transformer with 40–75% of its parameters.

segments.say: Against seven other looped designs, it has the lowest loss and the highest benchmark average at all three sizes we tested.
segments.display: Against seven other looped designs, it has the lowest loss and the highest benchmark average at all three sizes we tested.

segments.say: And at three billion parameters, it more than doubles word-problem accuracy, from two point six to six point four percent.
segments.display: And at 3B parameters, it more than doubles word-problem accuracy, from 2.6% to 6.4%.

segments.say: That's Loopback. Fewer parameters, lower loss. The paper and code are on our project page.
segments.display: That's Loopback. Fewer parameters, lower loss. The paper and code are on our project page.
